subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Lead Screws: Precision Linear Motion
description: One-minute skill: Lead Screws: Precision Linear Motion.

hook.text: Turn a bolt and it moves in or out. That's a lead screw in action.

buildup.text: A threaded shaft rotates inside a nut, converting spin to linear travel.

discovery.text: Fine threads give tiny steps per turn — ideal for precision positioning.

twist.text: Friction makes lead screws self-locking. The load can't backdrive the screw.

climax.text: CNC machines, microscope stages, and 3-D printers rely on lead screws.

punchline.text: A spiral thread turns rotation into surgical precision.

quiz.question: Why are lead screws self-locking?
options: A ratchet mechanism prevents reverse rotation
Thread friction is high enough that the load can't backdrive the screw
The nut expands under load and grips the shaft tighter
